children.name: Microcystis aeruginosa
children.description: Microcystis aeruginosa is a species of freshwater cyanobacteria that can form harmful algal blooms of economic and ecological importance.

children.name: Crocosphaera watsonii
children.description: Crocosphaera watsonii (strain WH8501) is an isolate of a species of unicellular (2.5-6 μm diameter) diazotrophic marine cyanobacteria which represent less than 0.1% of the marine microbial population.
